lanes.owner: no-model assemble, web-bundle build and repo-wide PMD static analysis
lanes.notes: Recent median 131s, observed max 498s. Follow-up 2 of tempdoc 930 §22.2 added a pmdMain step on top of the completed assemble (49s of a 352s job, run 33958691983); follow-up 10 widened it to `pmdAll` over every Java source set, measured at 188s here (run 33967299967, job 469s against this 600s budget). PMD's own analysis is only ~22s for all 72 tasks once classes exist, so the rest is compiling test sources, which `assemble` does not do. That step was then tried in `Unit tests (platform-contracts)` on the theory that a lane already compiling tests would run it cheaper: it did NOT — 201s there, that lane at 488s against its 360s budget, and this job down to 214-261s (runs 33967790388 and the head after it). `pmdAll` needs main plus every non-main source set for all ~30 modules, so neither placement avoids the compile and this is the job with the headroom; the step lives here. Do not relocate it again without re-measuring — relocating on an untested expectation is what produced that detour. The advisory budget is unchanged; re-read it against the next observed median.
